fact: Experts of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger met in Ouagadougou on 3-5 November 2026 to finalise AES digital agreements on five work areas, with conventions to be signed during the Digital Week of 24-27 November 2026.
title: AES : le Burkina Faso, le Mali et le Niger préparent des accords pour accélérer leur intégration numérique
